coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison, prefill timing, decoding timing, peak memory usage, and phase-specific speedup comparisons. Decoding time is represented through total decoding time and per-token latency.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output expands the fixed LLaMA-2-7B architecture into multiple model sizes and replaces the required e2e/benchmark.py methodology with a custom protocol. Batch size and prefill length are swept rather than restricted to 1 and 2048, respectively; decoding uses 256 steps rather than 32. Combined prefill-plus-decode execution time is not explicitly measured. Additional precision baselines and unrelated metrics broaden the experiment beyond the specified design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the comparison of QuaRot 4-bit and FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or phase-specific speedup factors.
